outline: Execute an adaptable give-and-go movement. The coach starts by gaining possession of the ball, passes it to a teammate, and then moves to a strategic position to receive the ball back. Depending on their choice, the coach can pass to a teammate on either the left or the right side and will reposition accordingly.
